setup.texto: This is the first time OPORTIA is opened. This account controls the whole platform: choose a username and a password you will not forget.
setup.nombre.ayuda: 3 to 40 characters, no spaces: letters without accents (a-z), numbers, dot, hyphen or underscore. Example: junior
setup.clave.ayuda: At least 6 characters, and not easy to guess (no 123456 or your own name). A short phrase is a good idea.
setup.claves_distintas: The two passwords do not match.
setup.tailscale.titulo: Open Tailscale to create your account
setup.tailscale.texto: For security, the administrator account can only be created from your own devices connected to Tailscale.
setup.tailscale.paso1: Open the Tailscale app on this device and make sure it says “Connected”.
setup.tailscale.paso3: If this message still appears on your iPhone, briefly turn off iCloud Private Relay and tap “Reload”.
entrar.olvide: Forgot your password? Ask the administrator to reset it.
clave.obligatoria: You signed in with a temporary password. Before continuing, choose your own.
clave.lista: Done: your password changed. Your other open sessions were closed.
inicio.texto: OPORTIA is being built in phases. This is what already works and what is coming.
inicio.funciona.1: Your account, with a protected password and locks against anyone trying to guess it.
inicio.funciona.3: User administration: create accounts and reset passwords.
inicio.viene.ia: Optional AI with a spending cap (phase 1, part d).
inicio.viene.copias: Nightly backups and Telegram alerts (phase 1, part e).
inicio.viene.clientes: Find clients in the Dominican Republic (phase 2).
admin.creado: Account created. Give {nombre} this temporary password; they will have to change it when they sign in:
admin.reiniciada: New temporary password for {nombre}; they will have to change it when they sign in:
admin.copiar_a_mano: It could not be copied automatically: it is now selected. Press and hold it and choose “Copy”.
admin.tu_cuenta: This is your account: change your password in Settings.
admin.confirmar_reiniciar: Reset {nombre}'s password? Their sessions will be closed.
admin.confirmar_desactivar: Deactivate {nombre}? They will not be able to sign in until you activate them again. Nothing is deleted.
inicio.funciona.4: Projects: you choose by tapping (or write in your words) what you need, OPORTIA shows you what it understood and you approve, pause or change it.
inicio.aprobar.vacio: Nothing is waiting for your approval.
proyectos.texto: Each project works separately. OPORTIA shows you what it understood and does nothing until you approve it.
proyectos.aviso_fase: For now OPORTIA saves, understands and organizes your projects. Finding customers starts in phase 2 and finding jobs in phase 6: then approved projects will start working on their own.
proyectos.vacio: You have no projects yet. Create the first one below.
proyectos.instrucciones.ayuda: Write it as you would tell a person: what you sell or what job you want, to whom, where and how often.
proyectos.ejemplo.1: I have a company that sells solar panels. I want to find hotels, clinics and factories in the Dominican Republic. Prioritize companies that have high electricity use.
proyectos.ejemplo.2: I want to find restaurants in Santo Domingo that need inventory systems.
proyectos.ejemplo.3: I am looking for work as a driver in Santiago. I want a salary of more than RD$25,000, preferably without required experience.
proyectos.solo_lectura: You can see these projects, but not change them.
proyectos.papelera.texto: What is here does not work and does not count toward your limit. Nothing is deleted: you can restore it.
proyecto.aviso_espera.comercial: Approved. It does not search yet: finding customers arrives in phase 2. When it does, it will start on its own with this setup.
proyecto.aviso_espera.laboral: Approved. It does not search yet: finding jobs arrives in phase 6. When it does, it will start on its own with this setup.
proyecto.aviso_borrador: This project has no approved version. Write again what you need or change the details, and approve it.
proyecto.en_papelera: This project is in the trash: it does not work. Restore it to use it again.
proyecto.error: It stopped because of an error: {motivo}
proyecto.pendiente.texto: Check it. Nothing happens without your approval.
proyecto.pendiente.cambio: Waiting for your approval. Version {numero} stays in use.
proyecto.pendiente.papelera: Restore the project to approve or change it.
proyecto.entendi.comercial: I understood that you want to find {sectores} in {zonas} that may need {producto}.
proyecto.entendi.laboral: I understood that you are looking for a job as {producto} in {zonas}.
proyecto.preguntas: Before approving, I need to know:
proyecto.supuestos: I decided this because you did not say it; change it if it is not right:
proyecto.no_se_puede_aprobar: It cannot be approved yet: first answer these questions.
proyecto.confirmar_papelera: Move “{nombre}” to the trash? It stops working, but nothing is deleted: you can restore it.
proyecto.listo.creado: Done. Check it and approve it if it is right.
proyecto.listo.guardada: Saved. Version {numero} is waiting for your approval.
proyecto.listo.rechazada: Version {numero} was rejected and kept in the history.
proyecto.listo.papelera: You moved it to the trash. Nothing was deleted.
campo.fuentes: Where the information will come from
valor.costo: US$0: OPORTIA's own engine does it, without AI.
capacidad.investigar.ayuda: Search and read sources: open data, websites, news and jobs.
capacidad.analizar.ayuda: Detect needs, problems, growth signals and risks.
capacidad.recomendar.ayuda: What to offer, to whom or which strategy to follow, always with the evidence behind it.
capacidad.propuestas.ayuda: A tailored sales proposal or job application.
capacidad.correos.ayuda: Personalized drafts, only when there is a real reason to write.
capacidad.contactar.ayuda: Send only the emails you approve, one by one. Never without your yes.
capacidad.supervisar.ayuda: Sort and summarize replies and suggest the next step.
faltante.producto.comercial: What do you sell or offer? Write it in “What you sell”.
faltante.producto.laboral: What job are you looking for? Write it in “Job you are looking for”.
faltante.sectores: What kind of businesses do you want to sell to? For example: hotels, clinics.
faltante.zonas: Where? Write provinces or cities, or check “The whole country”.
faltante.capacidades: Choose at least one thing the project will do.
faltante.dudas: There are things I did not understand. Review them in “Change the details by hand”.
duda.texto: I did not understand “{texto}”. If it matters, put it in the right field in “Change the details by hand” and mark it as fixed.
duda.lugar: I do not know the place “{texto}”. Write it as a province or municipality in “Where”.
duda.calle_o_provincia: “{texto}”: I do not know if it is the place (the province or the municipality) or an avenue or street. For now I search by province or municipality, not by street.
duda.direccion: “{texto}” looks like a street or an address. For now I search by province or municipality; if it matters, put it in “Give priority to”.
duda.conflicto_tamano: You set the size “{texto}” to search and also to exclude. Do you want it or not?
duda.conflicto_sector: “{texto}” is in “Who to look for” and also in “Exclude”. Do you want it or not?
duda.conflicto_zona: “{texto}” is in “Where” and also in “Exclude”. Do you want it or not?
duda.fuera_del_pais: “{texto}” is outside the Dominican Republic. For now I only search inside the country: remove it from “Where”.
duda.salario: I did not understand the salary in “{texto}”. Write the minimum and maximum in “Change the details by hand”.
duda.salario_periodo: “{texto}” is not a monthly salary. Write how much it would be per month in “Change the details by hand”.
duda.frecuencia: You gave more than one frequency (“{texto}”). Choose one in “How often it checks”.
duda.frecuencia_no_disponible: “{texto}”: for now I can check every day, every week, every month or only when you ask. Choose one in “How often it checks”.
duda.tipo: I do not know if this is for selling or for finding a job. Choose it in “What is it for?”.
duda.fuente: You asked to search in “{texto}”. Choosing where the information comes from will come later; for now I use open data, each company’s website and news.
duda.combinacion: You named different businesses for different places. I will look for all those businesses in all those places; if each place goes with its own business, better create one project for each.
duda.objetivo_competidores: Finding your competitors is not something I do yet: it will come later. For now I find customers for what you sell, or jobs.
duda.objetivo_proveedores: Finding suppliers is not something I do yet: it will come later. For now I find customers for what you sell, or jobs.
duda.objetivo_socios: Finding partners or investors is not something I do yet: it will come later. For now I find customers for what you sell, or jobs.
duda.objetivo_que_vender: Discovering what to sell is not something I do yet: it will come after phase 7. For now I need you to tell me what you sell.
duda.objetivo_una_empresa: Researching one particular company will come in phase 3. For now I find customers for what you sell, or jobs.
duda.objetivo_empleados: Finding employees for your business is not something I do yet: it will come later. For now I find customers for what you sell, or jobs.
duda.objetivo_otra_tarea: “{texto}”: that is not something I do yet. For now I find customers for what you sell, or jobs.
duda.parte_de_lugar: “{texto}”: I cannot search part of a city or province yet. If I go on, I will search the whole place; if that does not work for you, change it in “Where”.
duda.lugar_homonimo: More than one place is called “{texto}”. Check in “Where” which one I understood; if it is another one, write it with its province in “Change the details by hand”.
duda.lugar_difuso: “{texto}” is not an exact place. If any place in the country works for you, tick “The whole country” in “Where”; if not, write there the provinces or municipalities you want.
duda.lugar_inseguro: “{texto}”: I am not sure you want to search there, so I did not put it in “Where”. If you want it, write it in “Where” in “Change the details by hand”; then tick “I fixed it below, or it is not needed”.
duda.para_quien: “{texto}”: I understood it is who what you sell is for, so I did not put it in “Who to look for”. If you also want to look for those businesses, add them to “Who to look for” in “Change the details by hand”; then tick “I fixed it below, or it is not needed”.
duda.personas: “{texto}”: these are people, not businesses. I look for businesses and companies, not people (I only use public business information). Which businesses do you want to sell to? Write them in “Who to look for” in “Change the details by hand”; then tick “I fixed it below, or it is not needed”.
duda.lista_larga: A list cannot hold more than 30, so I left out “{texto}”. Fix it in “Change the details by hand” (for many places you can check “The whole country”).
duda.cambio: It looks like you changed your mind (“{texto}”). Check “Where” and “Who to look for” and keep only what you want.
duda.combinacion_producto: You named one product for each kind of business. This way I will look for all those businesses for everything you sell; if each product goes with its business, better create one project for each.
duda.combinacion_parcial: “{texto}”: I cannot set a rule for only one part yet (one place or one kind of business). I did not apply it; if you need it, create a separate project for that part.
duda.sector_general: You named specific businesses and also “{texto}” in general. Are you looking only for those businesses or for any kind of business? If it is any kind, leave only “All kinds of businesses” in “Who to look for”.
duda.tamano_del_general: You named specific businesses and also “{texto}”. I cannot yet search, in one project, those businesses of every size and also any business of that size. For now I look for the businesses you named, of every size. If you also want any business of that size, create another project for it; then tick “I fixed it below, or it is not needed”.
duda.lugar_provincia: “{texto}”: that place is not in that province. I do not know if you want both places or only one: leave in “Where” only what you want.
supuesto.capacidades: I will research and prepare proposals and emails, but I will not contact anyone.
supuesto.tipo: I understood it is for selling. If you are looking for a job, change it.
supuesto.sectores_todos: You did not say what kind of businesses: I will look at all of them.
supuesto.gran_santo_domingo: “Santo Domingo”: I will look in the National District and Santo Domingo province.
supuesto.tipo_laboral: I understood you are looking for a job. If it is for selling, change it.
supuesto.contactar_a_mano: You asked to contact people: I never switch that on by myself. If you want it, tick it yourself in “Change the details by hand”. Meanwhile I prepare the emails.
supuesto.salario_minimo: I took the salary you gave as the minimum you are looking for.
supuesto.producto_negocio: I understood you offer what your business does. If you sell something else, change it in “What you sell”.
supuesto.sectores_libres: Some businesses are not on my list: I keep them as you wrote them.
supuesto.dia_semana: I will check once a week; I cannot choose the day yet.
supuesto.telefono: I do not keep phone numbers in the project.
supuesto.contactar_sin_correos: You asked to call or contact people: I cannot make phone calls yet, and I never switch on contacting by myself. I do not prepare emails either, because you asked me not to.
supuesto.contactar_telefono: You asked to call people or write to them on WhatsApp: I cannot do that yet, and I never switch on contacting by myself. Meanwhile I prepare the emails, so you can use them yourself.
supuesto.clientes_actuales: I do not look for the ones who are already your customers as new customers: I put them in “Exclude”.
supuesto.clientes_sin_nombre: You asked me not to look for your current customers, but I do not know who they are yet: write their names in “Exclude”.
supuesto.personas_sueltas: I look for businesses and companies, not individual people: I cannot search for the people you mentioned.
supuesto.enviar_whatsapp: You asked me to send it by WhatsApp: I do not do that yet. You will see what I find here, in OPORTIA.
supuesto.autonomia_pedida: You asked me to do it without asking you. For now I keep the safest level: everything that goes out waits for your approval, and contacting someone always needs your “yes”. You can give me more freedom in “How much freedom it has”.
formulario.sectores: Who to look for (separate with commas)
formulario.zonas: Where: provinces or cities (separate with commas)
formulario.prioridades: Give priority to (one per line, up to 160 letters each)
formulario.experiencia: I prefer jobs without required experience
formulario.guardar.ayuda: Changes wait for your approval; meanwhile nothing changes.
formulario.dudas.ayuda: Fix each one in the right field and tick the box. The ones you do not tick stay as questions and the project cannot be approved.
formulario.duda_resuelta: I fixed it below, or it is not needed.
version.origen.campos: Changed by hand. The instructions were:
autonomia.aprobar_salidas: Everything that goes out waits for your approval (emails, sent proposals and contacts)
autonomia.frecuencia_aprobada: Works on its own at the approved frequency and lets you know
autonomia.contactar_siempre: Contacting anyone always needs your "yes", at every level.
aviso.clave_reiniciada: The administrator reset your password on {fecha}.
error.demasiados_intentos: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
error.demasiados_intentos_una_hora: Too many attempts. Wait an hour and try again.
error.demasiados_intentos_clave: Too many attempts with the current password. For safety your session was closed: sign in again.
error.cuenta_bloqueada_un_rato: This account is locked for 15 minutes after several failed attempts.
error.nombre_no_valido: The username must have 3 to 40 characters, no spaces: letters without accents (a-z), numbers, dot, hyphen or underscore.
error.clave_corta: The password must have at least 6 characters.
error.ya_existe_admin: An administrator account already exists. Sign in with it.
error.solo_desde_tailscale: The administrator account can only be created from Tailscale.
error.clave_actual_incorrecta: The current password is not correct.
error.clave_igual: The new password must be different from the current one.
error.ya_hay_otra_en_marcha: Another task of the same kind is already queued or running. Wait for it to finish.
error.arrancando: OPORTIA is starting. Wait a few seconds and try again.
error.no_puedes_desactivarte: You cannot deactivate your own account.
error.ultimo_admin: You cannot deactivate the only administrator.
error.origen_no_valido: Request rejected for security. Close OPORTIA and open it again.
error.no_has_entrado: Your session ended. Sign in again.
error.solo_admin: Only the administrator can do this.
error.error_interno: Something failed on the server. Try again in a moment.
error.datos_no_validos: The data sent is not valid.
error.formato_no_valido: The data sent is not valid.
error.demasiado_grande: What you sent is too large.
error.instrucciones_cortas: Write a bit more: at least 10 characters.
error.instrucciones_largas: It is too long: at most 4,000 characters.
error.limite_de_proyectos: You reached your plan's project limit. Send one to the trash to create another, or ask the administrator for more projects.
error.sin_espacio: Your account has no workspace. Tell the administrator.
error.solo_lectura: You can only view these projects.
error.en_papelera: That project is in the trash. Restore it first.
error.version_no_pendiente: That version is no longer waiting for approval: someone approved or changed it from another device.
error.faltan_datos: Details are missing to approve: complete what is asked.
error.accion_no_permitida_ahora: That can no longer be done: the project changed from another device.
error.nombre_proyecto_no_valido: The name must have 1 to 80 characters.
error.demasiadas_versiones: This project reached 100 saved versions, the maximum. Nothing is deleted: to keep changing it, create a new project with the instructions of the version in use (if you are at the limit, send this one to the trash first: it stays saved).
error.solo_dueno: Only the owner of this space can do this.
error.demasiados_guardados: You have too many saved projects (in use and in the trash) for your plan. Nothing is deleted: restore one from the trash and change it, or ask the administrator for more projects.
error.limite_para_restaurar: All the projects your plan allows are already in use. To restore this one, send another to the trash first, or ask the administrator for more projects.
error.version_demasiado_grande: This version is too long to save. Shorten the lists, the priorities or the instructions.
error.salario_no_valido: The salary must be a number, with no letters or signs.
error.salario_al_reves: The minimum salary cannot be higher than the maximum.
error.plan_menor_que_activos: That account has more projects in use than that plan allows. Nothing was changed: it has to send some to the trash first.
error.clave_obvia: That password is too easy to guess (like 123456, qwerty or your own name). Choose another one.
error.version_no_reusable: That version cannot be used again: it is in use or waiting for approval.
error.sin_conexion: No connection to the server. Check your internet.
inicio.viene.empleos: Find jobs in the Dominican Republic (phase 6).
inicio.aprobar.fase: Approving saves the project and leaves it ready, but it does not search yet: finding customers starts in phase 2 and finding jobs in phase 6.
aviso.clave_reiniciada.que_hacer: If you did not ask for it, tell the administrator.
aviso.clave_reiniciada.recientes: Resets of your password in the last {dias} days (also the ones you already saw):
aviso.clave_reiniciada.que_hacer_varios: If you did not ask for one of these dates, tell the administrator: someone may have entered your account.
config.reinicios.texto: Each time the administrator reset your password:
config.reinicios.vacio: The administrator has never reset your password.
tema.ayuda: Saved only in this browser. “Automatic” follows the device's light or dark mode.
admin.nuevo.nombre.ayuda: It is proposed from the name (Juan Pérez → juan.perez); you can change it. From 3 to 40 characters, no spaces: letters without accents or ñ (a-z), numbers, dot, hyphen or underscore.
admin.nuevo.plan: A new account starts with 1 project (“Trial” plan). Afterwards you can give it more in “Projects allowed”.
admin.nombre_ocupado_propuesta: That username already exists. I propose “{nombre}”: check it and tap “Create user” again.
admin.entra_con: They sign in with the username “{usuario}”.
admin.plan.igual: It already has that plan: nothing changed.
admin.plan.listo: Done: {nombre} can now have {n} projects in use.
admin.plan.admin: An administrator can always have at least 20.
admin.plan.es_admin: Administrator: up to {n} projects in use.
proyecto.aviso_antes.comercial: Approving it saves it and leaves it ready, but it does not search yet: finding customers starts in phase 2. When it arrives, it will start with this setup.
proyecto.aviso_antes.laboral: Approving it saves it and leaves it ready, but it does not search yet: finding jobs starts in phase 6. When it arrives, it will start with this setup.
proyecto.aviso_pausado: Paused: it does not work until you tap “Resume”.
proyecto.cambio_en_otro_lado: This changed on another device; this is how it is now. Check it before you continue.
proyecto.preguntas.lector: There are {n} unanswered questions: the owner has to answer them before approving.
proyecto.supuestos.lector: OPORTIA decided this because the instructions did not say it:
proyecto.no_entendi: What I did not understand (answer it before approving):
proyecto.listo.repetido: You had already sent it a moment ago: this is the same project (no other one was created).
proyecto.listo.copiada: Done: version {desde} was copied as version {numero}, which is waiting for your approval.
proyecto.reescribir.aviso: What is there now was changed by hand. “Understand again” replaces it with what it understands from these instructions (the ones from before your changes). The current one is not deleted: it stays in “Versions” and you can use it again.
proyecto.reescribir.confirmar: What you changed by hand is replaced with what it understands again (it stays saved in “Versions”). Continue?
proyecto.restaurar.texto: When restored it comes back paused: you decide when to resume it.
proyectos.reemplazar_texto: Replace what you wrote with this example? What you wrote will be lost.
valor.ia.permitida: Allowed, with a cap of {tope} a month
proximamente.fuentes: Choosing and adding sources: coming soon (phase 2).
proximamente.analisis: Type of analysis (basic, advanced or deep): coming soon (phase 2).
formulario.correos_por_contactar: It stays ticked because “Contact” needs it.
formulario.dudas.calculadas: These fix themselves when you correct the detail below:
version.usar_otra_vez.ayuda: It is copied as a new version waiting for your approval. Nothing is deleted.
sistema.actualizado: Refreshes by itself every 30 seconds. Last time: {hora}
sistema.sin_conexion: No connection to the server: this information is from {hora} and may be out of date. It tries again every 30 seconds.
sistema.resumen.en_pausa: Nothing runs until you turn it off
sistema.avisos.telegram: For now notices show here. Telegram notices arrive in phase 1, part e.
aviso.visto: It stays here until the problem is fixed (you saw it on {fecha}).
aviso.entendido.listo: Done: the notice is marked as seen. It stays here until the problem is fixed.
aviso.memoria_baja: The server is low on free memory: {mb}.
aviso.disco_bajo: The disk is almost full: {mb} free.
aviso.base_grande: The database is now {mb}. Telegram backups (phase 1, part e) accept up to 50 MB.
aviso.wal_grande: The database's pending-changes file is {mb}. It is tidied up by itself at the next check.
aviso.pantallas_lentas: In the last hour the screens took up to {ms} ms to respond.
aviso.trabajador_reinicios: Automatic work crashed {n} times in 24 hours. It restarts by itself.
aviso.modo_seguro: Automatic work is paused (safe mode). The screens work normally.
aviso.base_danada: The database check found a problem. Nothing was deleted. Ask for help before turning safe mode off.
aviso.tareas_fallidas: {n} tasks failed in the last 24 hours.
aviso.tareas_fallidas.uno: 1 task failed in the last 24 hours.
aviso.tareas_revisar: {n} tasks are waiting for a person to review them.
aviso.tareas_revisar.uno: 1 task is waiting for a person to review it.
aviso.fila_atrasada: Since {fecha}, some tasks have been waiting for their turn.
aviso.freno: “{tipo}” failed many times in a row: it is paused until {hora} and then tries again by itself.
tareas.fase.sin_respuesta: Not responding: it restarts by itself
tareas.freno.poca_memoria: Paused for low memory: it only keeps watch until memory frees up.
tareas.freno.poco_disco: Paused for low disk space: it only keeps watch until there is space.
tareas.frenado: “{tipo}” is paused until {hora} because it failed many times in a row.
tareas.atrasada: Since {hora}, the queue has been behind.
tareas.confirmar_cancelar: Cancel this task? It is not deleted: it stays in the list as cancelled and you can retry it later.
tareas.reintentada: Done: the task is back in the queue.
tareas.accion_ya_no: That can no longer be done: the task changed in the meantime. The list is already updated.
tareas.corridas: How it ended the last 5 times
tareas.explicacion: Automatic work runs apart from the screens and with lower priority: if it gets stuck or crashes, the screens keep working and it restarts by itself. For now it does the system's work: it checks the queue every hour and checks and tidies the database every night. Your projects start using it with the customer search (phase 2).
tareas.motivo.tiempo_agotado: took too long and was stopped
tareas.motivo.no_se_pudo_guardar: what it did could not be saved
tareas.evento.revisar: Needs a person to review it
tareas.evento.abandonada: Was interrupted and counts as a failure
tareas.evento.programa_saltado: Skipped a turn because the previous one was still going
tareas.como.sin_padre: Shut down because the screens closed
tareas.como.zombis: Restarted because a task was not responding
tareas.como.memoria: Ran out of memory and restarted
tareas.como.perdida: Stopped suddenly (power cut or server restart)
modo_seguro.activo.texto: Automatic work is paused. The screens work normally and nothing is lost: what is in the queue waits.
modo_seguro.apagado.texto: Automatic work runs normally. If something is wrong, you can pause it with this button.
modo_seguro.confirmar_activar: Turn safe mode on? All automatic work stops; the screens keep working and nothing is lost: what is in the queue waits and continues when you turn it off.
modo_seguro.confirmar_quitar: Turn safe mode off? Automatic work starts again and continues with what was in the queue.
modo_seguro.confirmar_quitar_base: The database check found a problem. It is best to ask for help before turning safe mode off. Turn it off anyway? When you do, the database is checked again right away.
modo_seguro.activado_listo: Done: safe mode is on. Automatic work shuts down in a few seconds.
modo_seguro.quitado_listo: Done: safe mode is off. Automatic work starts in a few seconds.
modo_seguro.motivo.trabajador_inestable: It turned on by itself: automatic work crashed 5 times in 15 minutes.
